text: I am allowed to take up space.
My worth is not measured by my productivity.
I am doing the best I can with what I know right now.
I don't have to earn rest.
I am more than my mistakes.
I am worthy of care, including from myself.
My feelings are valid, even when they're inconvenient.
I am allowed to grow at my own pace.
This feeling is temporary, even if it doesn't feel that way right now.
I can handle this one moment at a time.
I am safe in this present moment.
My breath is something I can always return to.
I don't have to solve everything today.
It's okay to not have all the answers right now.
I have gotten through hard moments before.
I would extend patience to a friend, I can extend it to myself too.
I am allowed to make mistakes and still be a good person.
I can be gentle with myself while still growing.
I don't have to be perfect to be worthy of kindness.
I am learning, not failing.
I have survived every hard day so far.
Small steps still count as progress.
I am capable of getting through this.
Difficult seasons don't last forever.
I can ask for help without it meaning I've failed.
It's okay to say no without a lengthy explanation.
My needs matter as much as anyone else's.
I can protect my energy without guilt.
Setting a boundary is an act of self-respect, not selfishness.
Right now, in this moment, I am okay.
I don't need to control everything to feel steady.
One thing at a time is enough.
I am exactly where I need to be to start.
